title: Vertical Construction Multiple Award Contract (MAC)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE GLOBAL STRIKE COMMAND > FA4626  341 CONS  LGC
description: This requirement is for the Vertical Construction Multiple Award Contract (MAC) at Malmstrom AFB, MT. The Vertical Construction MAC will be used to satisfy a multitude of vertical construction projects in support of the Malmstrom AFB installation and its missile alert/launch facilities.
